commit.message:
Unescape all quoted-pair sequences in WWW-Authenticate parameters (#305)

* fix: unescape all quoted-pair sequences in WWW-Authenticate parameters

The previous implementation only handled \" -> " in quoted parameter
values. RFC 7230 section 3.2.6 defines quoted-pair as a backslash
followed by any character, so \X -> X for any X. De-escape character by
character so that \\, \_, and other escape sequences are handled
correctly.

* test: cover RFC 7230 quoted-string unescaping in WWW-Authenticate parser

---------

Co-authored-by: Alex Bullitt <abullitt@apple.com>

commit.message:
test: assert transport behavior in the heartbeat failure test (#311)

The test simulated ECONNRESET, slept 500 ms, and expected the connection
state to be .failed. That is the state the mock sets itself, so the test
did not check anything the transport did. It was also flaky: the
transport cancels the connection before reconnecting, after
backoffDelay(for: 1), which is also 500 ms, changing the state to
.cancelled. When the cancel won the race, the test failed.

The test now waits, with a timeout, for the transport to cancel the
connection, then checks that it stops sending heartbeats.

commit.message:
Decode any percent-encoded byte in non-base64 data URLs (#310)

* fix: decode any percent-encoded byte in non-base64 data URLs

Non-base64 payloads were percent-decoded through a String round trip,
which rejected bytes that are not valid UTF-8 (e.g. %FF). Escapes are
now decoded directly into bytes, as RFC 2397 allows any octet.

* test: cover the RFC 2397 charset example and malformed escapes

commit.message:
Detect base64 from the data URL header, not the payload (#309)

* fix: detect base64 from the data URL header, not the payload

Data.parseDataURL decided base64 with string.contains(";base64,"), which
also searched the payload, so "data:text/plain,hello;base64,world" was
treated as base64 and returned nil even though isDataURL accepted it.
The regex now captures the optional ;base64 marker and that capture
drives the decision.

* test: cover ;base64 after a charset parameter

commit.message:
refactor: replace sendAndAwait with try await send(request).value (#304)

sendAndAwait was an internal shim that bridged the sync-throwing send()
and its async .value property, adding nothing beyond an extra name. All
internal call sites now use try await send(request).value directly,
which is the idiomatic Swift async throws pattern already documented on
RequestContext.

commit.message:
Fix PKCE verifier modulo-bias rejection threshold (#303)

* fix: correct PKCE verifier rejection-sampling threshold

makeVerifier maps random bytes onto a 66-character unreserved set using
rejection sampling. The threshold `255 - (255 % 66)` evaluates to 198,
so bytes 0...198 (199 values) were accepted and byte 198 wrapped to
index 0, making the first character slightly more likely than the
rest. The inline comment (`256 % 66 == 52`, `// 252`) was also wrong.

Use `66 * (256 / 66) - 1 = 197` so exactly 3 x 66 byte values are
accepted and every character is equally likely.

* test: add PKCE verifier tests

---------

Co-authored-by: Alex Bullitt <abullitt@apple.com>
